_about: Notes shown under the Septuagint where the Apostles quote its Greek wording. Each note goes live only when "approved": true (John reviews first). Preview all drafts on the site with ?lxxquotes=all. Written Nov 2026.

5:24.note: “he was not found, because God had taken him”

15:6.note: “Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness”

47:31.note: “leaning on the top of his staff” (the Hebrew reads “bed”)

32:43.note: “Let all God’s angels worship Him”: the Greek of this verse has lines that the Hebrew does not

16:9.note: “my flesh also will dwell in hope”

16:10.note: “nor will You let Your Holy One see decay”

40:6.note: “but a body You prepared for Me” (the Hebrew reads “ears You have opened”)

95:8.note: “as in the rebellion, in the day of testing”

102:25.note: “In the beginning, O Lord, You laid the foundations of the earth”

104:4.note: “He makes His angels winds, His servants flames of fire”

3:12.note: “and He chastises every son He receives”

3:34.note: “God opposes the proud, but gives grace to the humble” (also 1 Peter 5:5)

11:31.note: “if it is hard for the righteous to be saved”

6:9.note: “you will be ever hearing but never understanding” (also Acts 28:26)

11:10.note: “in Him the Gentiles will put their hope”

28:16.note: “the one who believes in Him will never be put to shame” (also 1 Peter 2:6)

29:13.note: “they worship Me in vain; they teach as doctrine the precepts of men” (also Mark 7:7)

40:3.note: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness” (also Mark 1:3, Luke 3:4, John 1:23)

40:6.note: “all its glory like the flowers of the field”

42:4.note: “In His name the Gentiles will put their hope”

52:5.note: “God’s name is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you”

53:7.note: “like a lamb before the shearer is silent”

53:8.note: “In His humiliation He was deprived of justice”

55:3.note: “the holy and sure blessings promised to David”

65:1.note: “I was found by those who did not seek Me”

31:32.note: “and I disregarded them” (the Hebrew reads “I was a husband to them”)

2:28.note: “in the last days … I will pour out My Spirit on all people”

9:12.note: “so that the remnant of men may seek the Lord” (the Hebrew reads “possess the remnant of Edom”)

2:4.note: “if he shrinks back, I will take no pleasure in him”
